title: Coulomb's Law
text: The electrostatic force between two point charges is F = kQ₁Q₂/r². The force is attractive for opposite charges and repulsive for like charges.

title: Understanding the Variables
text: k = 9 × 10⁹ N·m²/C² (Coulomb's constant), Q₁ and Q₂ are the charges in coulombs, r is the separation in metres.

title: Unit Conversions Needed
text: Convert μC to C: 1 μC = 10⁻⁶ C. Convert cm to m: 30 cm = 0.30 m.
